newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Denmark's Grundfos air freight shipments busy.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Grundfos air freight shipments busy.

text.p: Danish water pump maker Grundfos has been sending a lot of goods by air cargo lately, although volumes are less than in 1996, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"We have not been able to produce the parts for container transport so we have been sending by air freight," the head of Grundfos' shipping department, Kersten Bendtsen, told Reuters.
However, she said volumes were below last year's because of a company policy to reduce the amount sent by air in favour of cheaper sea options.
"We have sent smaller quantities than last year," she added.
She said the company had been sending its pumps and spare parts to Taipei, Adelaide and Singapore lately.
